verdict.rationale: A live probe found a working llms.txt (HTTP 200) at help.hummingbird.co that indexes the Help Center as markdown links, and the help pages are served as .md URLs, so an agent can be pointed at them directly. The .md.md probe returning 'Page Not Found' only reflects a doubled extension and does not contradict this. missing for 10: no llms-full.txt or other consolidated agent bundle in evidence, no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths 404), coverage limited to help-center articles rather than full API reference docs, no independent corroboration of agent usage.
